info.title: API.SH: Kmart Australia
info.description: The Kmart Australia API from API.SH: public Kmart Australia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status

parameters.name: route

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since

parameters.name: before

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Kmart's category tree with ids, names, product counts and links, `depth` levels below the top (or below one category).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id to list the branch under it.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels to return, 1-3 (default 2).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one Kmart category (with its parents), with the same fields, filters, sorts and facets as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id from /kmart/v1/categories.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands, several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in AUD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in AUD.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any facet as Name:value pairs, separated by `;`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 36).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Kmart product: everything in search plus the description, clearance and delivery flags, department and class, all images, every variant (size, colour, barcode, price, promo), category ids and the original record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product number such as 42442370 (the `id` in search results), or a kmart.com.au product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of one Kmart product: rating, title, text, nickname, location, date, recommended, helpful votes, badges, photos and replies; plus the average rating, review count and star distribution. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product number or kmart.com.au product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevant (default), newest, oldest, highest, lowest, helpful.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars, 1-5.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-100 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kmart Australia product search across Kmart's range and its marketplace, with every filter the shop offers: product number, link, name, brand, price, list price and promo price with dates, rating and review count, seller and marketplace flag, free shipping, preorder, badges, colour, size, variant count, sponsored flag and image. `facets` lists every filter for the query with counts, `categories` the matching categories. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Categories from the Category facet, several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Subcategories from the Subcategory facet.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product types from the Product Type facet.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands, several separated by `|` (e.g. Anko).

parameters.name: colour
parameters.description: Colours from the Colour facet.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Sizes from the Size facet.

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Sellers from the Seller facet (e.g. Kmart).

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: Marketplace shops from the Shops facet.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Materials from the Material facet.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: From the Gender facet.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in AUD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in AUD.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other facet as Name:value pairs from `facets`, separated by `;` (e.g. Pack Size:2 Pack).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 36).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Kmart Australia stock in nearby stores
get.description:
Stock of one or more Kmart products in the 3 stores nearest to a postcode (the stores the shop itself checks): per store the units on hand in store and the units available for click & collect, with the store's number, name, address, suburb, state, postcode, phone, coordinates and distance; plus the click & collect total across those stores. For sized or coloured products pass the variant's id (`variants[].id` from /kmart/v1/product). Unknown product ids answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-store-stock

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product or variant number (e.g. 42442370) or a kmart.com.au product link; up to 10, comma-separated.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: An Australian postcode (4 digits): the stores nearest to it.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true: only stores with at least one unit in store.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores to return, 1-3 (default 3).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kmart stores in Australia: every store (or one state's), the stores nearest to a postcode or a point, or one store by id. Each store has its number, name, street address, suburb, state, postcode, phone, coordinates, click & collect flag and trading hours for each day; nearby lookups add the distance in km.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-stores

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: An Australian postcode (4 digits): the 3 stores nearest to it, nearest first (for more, pass lat/lng).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a point in Australia (with lng): the stores within radius_km of it.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of a point in Australia (with lat).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: With lat/lng: search radius in km, 1-1000 (default 50).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One store by its number (`id` in the list, e.g. 1155).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: With no location: only stores in this state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: With lat/lng: stores to return, 1-100 (default 20); with postcode at most 3.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search suggestions Kmart shows while typing (with result counts and the categories each points to) and the top matching products.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kmart-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
